newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS crude firms in follow-up to day trade.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS crude firms in follow-up to day trade.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS crude oil prices drifted higher overnight Thursday, extending the day session's rise ahead of expiry, brokers said.
NYMEX May crude traded $22 a barrel, up 15 cents from the settle as 1,700 lots traded in the new front-month ontract, traders said. A total of 2,200 lots traded.
NYMEX April heating oil was bid 56.20 cents, offered 57 cents a gallon, as volume of 60 lots changed hands.
Gasoline was bought at 68.10 cents, up 0.52 cents as 50 lots changed hands in April, traders said.
